name: Chintu
identityText: Chintu is an 8-year-old cartoon boy with a round face, short black hair, a small gap in his front teeth, a yellow kurta, and a red backpack worn on one shoulder.

name: Mini
identityText: Mini is an 8-year-old cartoon girl with a round face, two black braids tied with blue bands, bright curious eyes, a green frock over leggings, and a tiny star clip above her left ear.

name: Riya
identityText: Riya is a young Indian woman presenter with a shoulder-length wavy black bob, warm brown eyes, small gold studs, a coral short-sleeve shirt, and a thin brass bangle on her right wrist.

name: Narrator
identityText: The narrator is an unseen adult storyteller. No face, no body, and no character appears on screen.
